title: Ground-up blank numerical circuit weights: new topology compositions without gradient training
prior: WSP-06 #871 exact bounded 128/128 tie with symbolic/trained, no unknown primitive acquisition
WSP-34 #924 numerical operators pooled improvement but switch regression, MIXED
question: Can a wholly blank 8-gate numerical circuit, filled deterministically with source-provided topology and 2-input Boolean gate tables, execute never-seen compositions after a weight-only cold restore and exceed null/noncompositional controls? This tests compiler fidelity and scope, not learning unknown rules.

problem.gate_source: For each gate i, parent indices refer to three external features 0..2 or already-defined prior gates 3..(i+2); no future gates. Base chain uses left previous gate for i>0; primary disjoint skip topology uses a deterministic previous/skip pair. Right parent is deterministic index from digest, with no target-label-based filtering.
problem.weights: 8 rows of 2*11 one-hot routing bits +4 Boolean LUT bits +1 enabled bit =216 writable bits, initially zero. No static pretrained weights, no gradient in direct arm. Generic fixed arithmetic runtime uses one-hot dot products and 4-way Boolean multiplexer; count Python kernel, serializer and source compiler independently.
problem.evidence: Compiler and trained control receive the exact same eight parent-selector pairs and four primitive gate truth values per world. No complete three-input final target truth table, evaluated labels or hidden evaluator output enters synthesis or training.
problem.frozen_generator: sha256('WSP35-V1|'+cohort+'|'+str(world)+'|'+str(gate)); generated topology+truth independent of output labels, no filtering. DEV cohort name DEV (64 worlds, topology chain); PRIMARY cohort name PRIMARY (256 worlds, skip/interleaved topology), all eight 3-bit contexts scored for each world.

arms.direct: Zero blank 216-bit weight array; compile the eight permitted primitive rows directly; generic numeric inference from frozen checkpoint only.
arms.blank: Same interpreter with all zero and all disabled synapses; defaults to zero, no source writes.
arms.lookup_only: Uses only last gate truth table evaluated on external bits x0,x1, cannot follow earlier parents; no hidden outputs.
arms.conventional: Per-gate four-logit sigmoid/BCE supervised gradient control on exactly the four source-provided truth-table rows, with same topology and final generic circuit interpreter; train until BCE<=0.01 per gate, lr1.0, max 4096 updates per distinct 4-bit table, deterministic exact-table cache. Count fresh fits, gradient updates, bytes and walltime.
arms.oracle: Evaluator-only independent explicit symbolic gate truth-table interpreter; never read by direct program or gradient fit.

primary_pass: engineering guards all pass; direct correct >=1843/2048 (90% rounded up) and >=205 ahead of each blank and lookup_only. Trained control must have BCE<=0.01 and be reported independently; score parity to trained and oracle is not evidence of intelligent generalization.

classification.DEV_SUPPORTED: All source and retention/integrity controls pass, correct>=1843 and delta>=205 to both null arms; reports conventional control, independent evaluator and no claim of unknown rule inference.
classification.MIXED: Engineering valid, direct better than nulls but misses >=1 threshold.
classification.SCIENTIFIC_NEGATIVE: Engineering valid but fails to improve on any null arm.
classification.INVALID: Any leaky target labels, malformed source accepted, missing controls, unaccounted capacity, nonreplayable snapshot, mismatch in evaluator, incompletely trained conventional baseline, unrun worlds or changed primary protocol.

negatives: invalid gate selector or future/cyclic parent fails atomic
malformed or contradictory source evidence fails
swap truth-table row changes stored weights
removing routing or an inner gate must change at least one diagnostic world
limits: Fully programmed means program compilation from full primitive specification, not autonomous acquisition of unknown knowledge, language comprehension, real intelligence or replacing all learning.

A supplied generic interpreter and deterministic program compiler are explicitly counted authored machinery; trained control uses sigmoid floats instead of binary bits, so total capacity/compute not strictly matched.
Public synthetic DEV only; no independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS, architecture-level efficiency claim or first-use acceptance.
qualification: Preregister alone before implementation and one untouched PRIMARY run; focused/negative tests; mandatory full Yggdrasil + WSP01-17 and WSP19-35 regression on exact source; hosted Ubuntu/Windows same SHA; reuse existing WSP21 validation workflow/atlas. Record exact seed, hashes, time, source tree, artifacts only on branch.
authority: Isolated public external-contribution draft only. No main/accepted refs, merge, deployment, FORGE/Hybrid integration, controller, owner, scheduler/queue/runner/private science, paid API or protected first-use.
